outgoing.name: Aesthetics
outgoing.excerpt: IRSO focused more on stunt-oriented and gymnastic/athletic type jump rope moves, while the WRSF focused more on the aesthetics and form of jump roping.

outgoing.name: Belgium
outgoing.excerpt: Belgium, Canada, Germany, Great Britain, Hungary, Japan, and the United States of America each medalled.

outgoing.name: Cambridge
outgoing.excerpt: Skipping took place in Cambridge and in several Sussex villages and indeed still takes place every Good Friday in the East Sussex village of Alciston.

outgoing.name: Folklore
outgoing.excerpt: English folklore suggests that skipping had it's origins in the rope with which Judas Iscariot hanged himself after his betrayal of Christ.
